name: 45424-guidedjson-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1), sm90.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, `--distributed-executor-backend uni`, one GPU.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=256, request rate unbounded. 6400 requests, 10% warmup and 10% cooldown by completion, leaving 5120 scored. Safety cap 1800 s.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, SINGLE TURN, exactly 128 prompt tokens and exactly 256 output tokens (min = max on both), `request_format: plain`, temperature 0.0, seed 1, prompts drawn independently. Every request is constrained to the eight-field `SupportTicket` JSON object declared in `scenario.json` (five strings, two string arrays, one boolean, all required).
purpose: A support-ticket tagging service returning fixed JSON from an 8B model, 256 concurrent short requests on one GPU.
launch:
# Engine arguments for an IN-PROCESS engine (guidellm `vllm_python` backend), not a `vllm serve`
# command line: that usage context does not take the same defaults, so the batch keys below are
# pinned rather than left implicit.

model: Qwen/Qwen3-8B

tensor-parallel-size: 1
distributed-executor-backend: uni

dtype: bfloat16

max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 1024

enable-prefix-caching: false
max-model-len: 2048

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
